Dear [Mr Bullock](/person/221),
If you can wait a little while for St Maurice I will send him to you but I am very busy just now, and could not turn my mind to it immediately. I have Baring Gould and [Alban Butler](/organisation/27) both also Fleury[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘The Revd J.F.

Bullock/Radwinter Rectory/Saffron Walden.

Postmark MR 19/94.
[^2]: CMY perhaps refers to Claude Fleury, Histoire ecclesiastique (1691-1720) ; she may have known it in Newman’s translation, The Ecclesiastical History of M. l\'abbé Fleury, from the Second Ecumenical Council to the end of the Fourth Century (Oxford: Parker 1842-4).

She is talking about the work she was doing for Bullock\'s Daily Lections project.
